metadata.author: Carl Zimmerman
metadata.purpose: Determine if Z-strained stanene survives flue gas temperatures

T_min_150C.stability_notes: WARNING: T = 150°C is >70% of melting point; NOTE: Analysis assumes substrate-supported stanene; Freestanding stanene may buckle at high strain

T_typical_200C.stability_notes: WARNING: T = 200°C is >70% of melting point; NOTE: Analysis assumes substrate-supported stanene; Freestanding stanene may buckle at high strain

T_max_300C.stability_notes: WARNING: T = 300°C is >70% of melting point; NOTE: Analysis assumes substrate-supported stanene; Freestanding stanene may buckle at high strain

at_200C.message: Need to cool 123 K, requiring ~110.7 MW

at_300C.message: Need to cool 223 K, requiring ~200.7 MW

ZrW2O8.notes: Best NTE material, but epitaxy unclear

Engineered_metamaterial.notes: Could be designed to match stanene expansion

bilayer_analysis.notes: BN substrate could reduce effective expansion by ~50%

verdict.key_uncertainty: 2D stanene thermal expansion coefficient not well characterized

recommendations: Use NTE substrate (BN or ZrW2O8) for thermal compensation
Measure actual α for fabricated stanene samples
